newsitem.title: SPAIN: Mapfre to pay unchanged 175 ptas total div.
newsitem.headline: Mapfre to pay unchanged 175 ptas total div.

text.p: Spanish insurance group Corporacion Mapfre Cia Internacional de Reaseguros SA will pay a total dividend of 175 pesetas gross per share against 1996 results, unchanged versus 1995, chief executive Manuel Martinez said on Thursday.
Mapfre paid an interim dividend of 85 pesetas gross on December 15, but did not give a date for the remaining 90 peseta dividend payment.
"Our dividend policy has always been to pay the same dividend for two or three years," Martinez told journalists.
Corporacion Mapfre posted net attributable profit of 9.74 billion pesetas in 1996 versus 9.57 billion the previous year.
